status_summary: On 2025-08-11 EPA reported that a dedicated team had cleared a backlog of low-volume exemption reviews under the TSCA new chemicals program, raising monthly risk assessments from 15 to 53. On 2025-09-18 the EPA Administrator announced prioritized review of new chemicals for data center projects and covered components, for submissions received on or after 2025-09-29. No revision of the new chemicals regulations, no proposal to change the fees rule, and no step transferring Safer Choice to the private sector was found; trade press in June 2025 reported the program continuing inside the chemicals office.

timeline.event: EPA released results of a push to speed review of low-volume exemptions in the TSCA new chemicals program, reporting 106 reviews completed in two months and a drop in reviews pending more than 30 days.
The EPA Administrator announced prioritized TSCA review of new chemicals for data center projects and covered components under Executive Order 14318, for submissions received on or after 2025-09-29.

title: Reset the TSCA new chemicals program, right-size the fees rule, move Safer Choice private
uncertainties: The two EPA releases were read on epa.gov (the data center prioritization is now cited from EPA rather than a law-firm summary); backlog figures, fee-authority status and Safer Choice status rest on law-firm and trade-press summaries, not primary documents. The CRS report states that fee authority expires at the end of fiscal year 2026 and that discussion drafts to reauthorize it circulated in January and February 2026; a law-firm advisory dated 2026-10-02 reports a stopgap funding law signed 2026-09-02 extended it to 2026-12-11, but the law number was not found and it is not in the timeline. The legislation is about authority, not a fees-rule revision. A Safer Choice Program Authorization Act of 2026 (S. 4664) was reported introduced in June 2026 per the law-firm update; it was not checked on congress.gov, and it would codify rather than privatize the program. The September 2025 proposed amendments to the risk evaluation framework are tracked in c13-18. Searches run: Federal Register API (new chemicals, fees, Safer Choice, risk evaluation procedures) and three web searches. In this pass the Federal Register API was searched for EPA documents since 2025-01-20 on TSCA new chemicals and TSCA fees: results were only significant new use rules, new chemical receipt and status notices, statements of findings, the September 2025 risk evaluation procedures proposal, and an information collection notice on TSCA user fees (2026-09-10; comments to 2026-11-09). No proposed or final rule revising the new chemicals review regulations or the fees rule appeared, and the individual Unified Agenda entries for EPA were not opened. Both EPA releases were re-read and match the record (EO 14318 is titled Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure).
